events.title: Webpack 5 released
events.summary: Webpack 5.0 shipped on October 10, 2020 with persistent caching, module federation, and improved tree-shaking.
events.about: Webpack 5's module federation let micro-frontends share dependencies at runtime — a pattern adopted by large enterprises. Persistent caching sped CI builds; better tree-shaking reduced bundle sizes for React and Vue apps still on webpack before Vite's rise.

narrative.whyChosen: Webpack 5 module federation changed how teams composed large frontends.
narrative.whyImportant: Runtime sharing of modules enabled independent deployable micro-frontends.
narrative.problemSolved: Monolithic frontends could not be split into independently deployed apps without duplicate bundles.
